Bottom line

DALL·E 3's biggest advantage is where it lives: inside ChatGPT, which most people already have open. It follows detailed, literal instructions unusually well, which makes it forgiving for beginners, even if the output leans less photorealistic and less stylistically distinctive than Midjourney's.

Frequently asked questions

Is DALL·E 3 free?

Yes, it's available for free through ChatGPT's free tier with usage limits, or unlimited-ish on paid plans.

Do I need a ChatGPT subscription to use DALL·E 3?

No, but paid plans raise the usage limits and priority access.

Can I use DALL·E 3 images commercially?

Yes, commercial usage rights are included — check current OpenAI terms for specifics.

Is DALL·E 3 better than Midjourney?

It's easier to prompt and free to start; Midjourney generally wins on raw image quality.

Can DALL·E 3 edit existing images?

Yes, basic in-context editing is supported within ChatGPT.

When was DALL·E 3 last tested by Luvent?

We last tested it on 2026-06-20.
